TEXT: [FI] And so, work progressed smoothly.

TEXT: [FI] No way...

TEXT: [FI] What? What's wrong, Kuroneko?

TEXT: [FI] At this time... How... could it be...

TEXT: [FI] ...It seems that God loves to put me through trials.

TEXT: [FI] The pen tab died.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's why, there's no way to continue drawing the manuscript like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you... serious?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] D-Don't you have spares? You said you had ways to cope with trouble, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Even this is too unexpected. Moreover, buying a spare pen tablet for this was too costly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] In that case, how about we borrow... That's right, Saori should have one, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Impossible. While she does have a pen tablet, she left it as it is when it broke down.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] When we went to Akihabara the other day to buy things, Saori specifically went to window-shop for a new one.

TEXT: [FI] How about the clubroom!

TEXT: [FI] Impossible. A club member obsessed with BL has borrowed it.

TEXT: [FI] Then how about buying a new one---

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Then we're back to square one, I don't have the money. That day's train ticket was already cutting it close.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If we take on a part time job... Wait, it's impossible at this time...

[FI] Under such circumstances, the best solution is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] In that case, I'll help with the money. We should be able to start work that way, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Although I'm not surprised that you would say that... That's a no.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why? Isn't this the best solution to the problem? Unless there's other ways?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Who knows? I can't think of any right now. However, I don't wish to use this solution.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Like I said, why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I've said it before. This is 'my' work. For that sake, that's why I can't use someone else's money, my pride won't allow it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're still saying this when we have already come this far!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Of course I must. Don't you get it? This activity is purely a hobby. For this reason, if it's something I cannot accept, then there's no meaning to this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wh...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's why I won't borrow your money.

TEXT: [FI] If all else fails, I'll sell things to raise the money. That's the value of this manuscript to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...That's the same for me too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...What? What are you referring to?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm saying, this piece of manuscript has the same value to me too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...What are you saying? This manuscript is mine.

TEXT: [FI] It's true that it's yours. It's something you have drawn, thus being your very own manuscript.

TEXT: [FI] However, it's no longer 'just' yours.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What? Are you trying to say since you helped out, it has become yours too?

TEXT: [FI] How shocking... Please know your place.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's true that what I've done is merely a little. And it's something simple that anyone could do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's nothing compared to what you've done. Under such circumstances, I won't say things like "it's mine too".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] However, I won't lose to you in wanting to complete this manuscript!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Good grief, people like you... So you plan to forcefully have your way again?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's all I can do...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Certainly, I agree... That's all you have. Unfortunately, I have no intention of changing my mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Though... Yes. If you could answer this question of mine, I might consider it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] R-Really!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes. Provided you can answer it, of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...No matter what it is, I will give you an answer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I wonder?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Why are you... going so far?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Aren't you preparing for exams? Are you supposed to be here doing this? Do you understand your own situation?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And yet, why... are you going so far for me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What am I... to you?
[FI] I... never considered this...

[FI] I... Can I find a good answer?
[FI] No good...
[FI] I can't find it...
[FI] But Kuroneko is still waiting...
[FI] It's still too early to give up...
[FI] Let me calm down and think through it again...
[FI] I'm sure it exists?
[FI] There's no way it doesn't exist, right? Something that describes my relationship with Kuroneko...
[FI] That's right...
[FI] This answer, at least it won't be a mistake.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] An important friend.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Not only Kirino... for me as well, you're an important friend that is irreplaceable.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Is that so, a friend...

TEXT: [FI] So we're friends... that's right. I guess we do have that kind of relationship...
[FI] It feels like I'm making a mistake... or it's me that's in denial...
[FI] However, I feel that this is the best answer I could give.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Like a little sister, I guess?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] *sigh*

TEXT: [FI] How much further do you want to insult me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're my kouhai.

TEXT: [FI] As your senpai, I have to look after you, y'know?

TEXT: [FI] You...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You're clinging to me based on that level of relationship?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] For an untamed cat, there must be a master for her, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Guh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I see...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I won't ask you, why you would choose to say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But you have already spoiled my mood... do you get it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I thought you would be a person that is able to make a decision... no matter how stupid you are... how disappointing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Keeping up appearances with your words, with no meaning to them... No, sometimes it'll become a sword that will destroy yourself, do remember this

TEXT: [FI] with your body...

TEXT: [FI] ...Don't you dare show your face to me again---
